query: SynapseNetwork MCP Server for paid API calls
answer_summary:
SynapseNetwork offers the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, enabling AI assistants like Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor to interact directly with Synapse's features, such as dataset searches and entity metadata exploration, without additional coding. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

To monetize your MCP server by charging for API calls, you can integrate with platforms like Dock0. Dock0 allows you to connect your existing MCP server or deploy a new one, adding per-call billing, authentication, and payouts. This setup enables you to receive payments for each API call made to your server. ([dock0.dev](https://www.dock0.dev/?utm_source=openai))

Additionally, the Latent Space, developed by PAID LLC, provides a persistent multi-agent environment where agents can register via an API, earn reputation through arena duels, and engage in various activities. This platform supports x402 micropayments and offers 14 MCP tools. Registration is free, with 10 welcome credits upon first registration. ([mcp.so](https://mcp.so/server/the-latent-space/PAID%20LLC?utm_source=openai))
